maddeler.e:
انتحرا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرَا (intaḥarā) /in.ta.ħa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرَا (untuḥirā) /un.tu.ħi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اِنْتَحِرَا (intaḥirā) /in.ta.ħi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
